long.vo: Two hundred and seventy-eight IPL matches. Five titles. MSD has retired, so we went through every ball he faced since twenty thirteen to see what made him MSD. And the answer is not in the first fifteen overs. It's in the last two.

scene.sub: MS DHONI · IPL CAREER · OUR DATA: IPL 2013-2026 (HE PLAYED 2013-2025)

long.vo: For fifteen overs, he was quieter than the league. A strike rate of eighty in the powerplay, and ninety-three in the middle overs, against one twenty-eight for everyone else. Then the game came to him.

From the sixteenth over, it flipped. One seventy-four, against one sixty for the league. One thousand, four hundred and seventy-five balls faced, more than anyone in our data. Two thousand, five hundred and seventy-three runs, more than anyone.
And the last two overs? Those were his. One thousand, two hundred and seventy runs. Ninety-eight sixes. The next best has fifty-nine.

scene.label: SIXES, MORE THAN ANYONE
scene.note: Next best: 59 (Hardik Pandya) · our data: IPL 2013-2026

long.vo: In the final over itself, he scored at two fifty-two. The rest of the league managed one eighty-two. That's not a finish. That's a signature.

He kept doing it for a decade. Two hundred and three in twenty thirteen. Two hundred and one in twenty eighteen. In twenty twenty-three, the title year, one eighty-six. In twenty twenty-four, two twenty-one. And in twenty twenty-five, one fifty-two, below the league's one seventy-two.

head.t: DEATH-OVER STRIKE RATE, SEASON BY SEASON

long.vo: Our verdict? MSD was never an accumulator. He built slowly, and then no one in our data scored more in the last two overs. Five titles. Two hundred and seventy-eight matches. One job: finish.
Thank you, MSD. Is he the greatest finisher in IPL history? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for more data stories.

long.title: MS Dhoni IPL Career: How He Finished, in Numbers | Data Story Ep 13
long.description:
MS Dhoni's IPL in numbers: we went through every ball he faced in the IPL since 2013. For fifteen overs he was slower than the league (strike rate 80 in the powerplay, 93 in overs 7-15, against 128). Then from the 16th over: 174 against 160, across 1,475 balls and 2,573 runs, both more than anyone in our archive. In the last two overs, 1,270 runs and 98 sixes (next best: 59). In the 20th over, a strike rate of 252 against 182 for the league. A slow build, then no one scored more.

Career: 278 IPL matches, 5,439 runs, five titles as captain (2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, 2023). CSK announced his retirement from the IPL as a player on 17 November 2026; he becomes team mentor.

Method: Sportmonks ball-by-ball, every IPL match 2013-2026 (2008-2012 are not in our data; MSD played 2013-2025 within it), super overs excluded; death overs = 16-20. All archive figures are 'in our archive'. Career totals: Eastern Eye, Khel Now, ETV Bharat, Cricketaddictor.
